instructions.name: create_external_market
docs: Attach a market to a token that launched on an external venue
(Meteora DBC into DAMM). The mint is external with fixed supply, so
the market starts Live immediately: CDP supply flows through the
program treasury, which must be funded with reserve tokens (plain
SPL transfer) before shorts can open. The mark price is
oracle-pushed via push_mark.

accounts.name: synth_mint
docs: The externally launched token mint (e.g. created by Meteora DBC).

instructions.name: deposit_item
docs: Deposit a registered item and receive tokens worth the item: the
card's live index value divided by the token's mark price. Tokens
come from the preminted item reserve, so supply stays fixed.

accounts.name: escrow_item
docs: The market's escrow for this specific item mint.

instructions.name: push_mark
docs: Oracle-pushed mark price for external-venue markets, in lamports
per whole underlying unit. The relayer computes it from the
external pool off chain; on chain it is EMA-smoothed and
rate-limited, and funding clamps bound what a bad push can move.

instructions.name: register_item
docs: Register an item mint (a specific vaulted-card NFT or collection
NFT) as depositable into a market's item pool. Admin-gated in v1;
on-chain collection verification replaces this at devnet.

instructions.name: release_escrow
docs: Release an identity fee escrow. The escrow is a program-derived
system account seeded by the hash of the identity (e.g.
sha256("youtube:pokerev")); fees for unverified identities
accumulate there via plain transfers. No key exists for it: funds
can only leave through this admin-signed instruction after
off-chain ownership verification, to the verified wallet.

instructions.name: update_market_params
docs: Admin risk-parameter update. Curve virtual reserves are immutable
after creation; the running curve state is never touched.

instructions.name: withdraw_item
docs: Return tokens worth one item and take a copy out of the escrow.

accounts.name: escrow_item
docs: The market's escrow for this specific item mint.

errors.name: NotBootstrap
errors.msg: market is not in bootstrap phase

errors.name: PushTooSoon
errors.msg: oracle push too soon after previous push

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: CrankTooSoon
errors.msg: funding crank too soon after previous crank

errors.name: ImmutableParam
errors.msg: parameter cannot be changed after market creation

errors.name: WrongVenue
errors.msg: instruction not available for this market venue

errors.name: TreasuryDepleted
errors.msg: treasury reserve cannot cover this mint

errors.name: ItemReserveDepleted
errors.msg: item reserve cannot cover this deposit

errors.name: ItemNotRegistered
errors.msg: item is not registered for this market

errors.name: ItemNotInEscrow
errors.msg: item escrow does not hold this item

types.name: ItemRegistration
docs: Admin-registered item mint eligible for a market's item swaps (a
vaulted-card NFT or collection NFT verified off chain in v1).

fields.name: collection
docs: Identifies the NFT collection (verified collection mint address).

fields.name: frozen
docs: Circuit breaker flag. Blocks everything except add_collateral and admin ops.

fields.name: mark_ema
docs: Mark price EMA, lamports per whole NFT.

fields.name: funding_index
docs: Cumulative funding index, FUNDING_ONE fixed point.

fields.name: items_deposited
docs: Items currently held by the market's item escrow.

fields.name: index_window_secs
docs: Time window for the index TWAP (EMA weighting), seconds.

fields.name: min_push_interval_secs
docs: Minimum seconds between oracle pushes.

fields.name: breaker_bps
docs: Push deviating from TWAP by more than this freezes the market.

fields.name: max_index_age_secs
docs: Index older than this blocks shorts, withdrawals, funding, and
liquidations. 0 disables the guard.

fields.name: mark_window_secs
docs: Window for the AMM mark EMA, seconds.

fields.name: funding_k_bps
docs: Funding sensitivity: rate_per_day = premium * funding_k_bps / 10000.

fields.name: max_funding_bps_per_day
docs: Absolute clamp on funding, bps of debt per day.

fields.name: min_crank_interval_secs
docs: Minimum seconds between funding cranks.

fields.name: initial_cr_bps
docs: Collateral ratio to open or withdraw, bps (e.g. 15000 = 150%).

fields.name: maintenance_cr_bps
docs: Collateral ratio below which liquidation opens, bps.

fields.name: liq_bonus_bps
docs: Liquidator bonus, bps of repaid debt value.

fields.name: max_open_interest
docs: Cap on total CDP debt, token base units.

fields.name: item_reserve
docs: Preminted allocation backing item swaps, token base units. Zero
disables item swaps for the market.

fields.name: units_per_item_micro
docs: How many synth units (1M tokens each) one physical item was worth
at launch, in millionths. The curve prices every launch at the
same 25 -> 100 SOL market cap span regardless of the underlying,
so the oracle index is launch-scaled and this factor carries the
item's real size into item swaps. 1_000_000 = one unit per item.

fields.name: curve_fee_bps
docs: Curve trade fee, bps.

fields.name: amm_fee_bps
docs: AMM trade fee, bps.

fields.name: graduation_target_sol
docs: Real SOL raised on the curve that triggers graduation.

fields.name: insurance_share_bps
docs: Share of raised SOL that seeds the insurance fund at graduation, bps.

fields.name: curve_virtual_sol
docs: Initial virtual SOL reserve for the curve, lamports.

fields.name: curve_virtual_tokens
docs: Initial virtual token reserve for the curve, base units.

fields.name: debt_scaled
docs: Debt in base units divided by funding_index at last touch, FUNDING_ONE scaled.
